target_customer: Fintechs, lenders and banks that embed liability connectivity, data and repayment into their apps
problem: Connecting to and paying consumer debts programmatically required brittle lender integrations and paper-check processing. Method offers one API using a phone number instead of login credentials.
business_model: usage-based B2B API (Connect, Data, Pay products)
product_category: financial account connectivity API for consumer liabilities

founders.name: Jose Bethancourt
education: UT Austin, Computer Science and Business
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a two-time founder with one exit; source: YC company page.

founders.name: Jesus Marco del Carmen
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no background; TechCrunch 2025 names him as co-founder and GradJoy builder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reaching liability data and payments across many lenders without credentials, and moving money, required many integrations and compliance work; the 2019 student loan app GradJoy ran into those integration limits per TechCrunch 2025.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integrations and payment connections are slow to copy, but connectivity rivals such as Plaid and MX could extend into liabilities.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: As of 2025 Plaid, MX, Spinwheel and Dwolla remain named competitors per TechCrunch; no acquisition of Method found.

market_need_then: The YC S19 team built GradJoy for student loans and found lender APIs brittle and repayment dependent on paper checks, which later motivated the API (TechCrunch 2025).

branding.domain_note: Uses methodfi.com, not an exact method.com match.

identity.logo: Refreshed wordmark in a 2024 rebrand, designed to animate in motion
identity.visual_style: Moved from dark developer green to a cyan highlight called Method Opal, with electric gradients and supergraphics
identity.voice_and_tone: Uplifting, bold, humanized, stressing trust, security and consumer control

branding.brand_signature: Method Opal cyan color in the 2024 identity

rebrands.why: Company moved beyond connectivity into data and payments (blog post dated December 3, 2024; metadata date conflicts)

brand_strength.rationale: Only the company's own rebrand post and generic name found; no press on the brand or community evidence.

pivots.from: GradJoy, a student loan management app (YC S19)
pivots.to: Method, a debt connectivity and repayment API
pivots.why: Integration pain at GradJoy led the founders to build infrastructure (TechCrunch 2025)

outcome_analysis: Method pivoted from the YC S19 student loan app GradJoy into an API for consumer liability connectivity in 2021 and has since raised a pre-seed, a 16M Series A led by a16z in 2023 and a 41.5M Series B led by Emergence in 2025, with about 60M total. It is active with customers like SoFi, and faces Plaid, MX, Spinwheel and Dwolla.
